title: Japan Fair Trade Commission raids four major Japanese brewers on suspicion of price cartel
summary: The JFTC investigates Asahi, Kirin, Sapporo, and Suntory for alleged secret meetings to coordinate shipping prices of beer and happoshu.

title: Agriculture Minister Yana denies resigning over controversy over road budget requests to his district
summary: The Ministry of Land concludes there is no evidence of pressure, but the opposition demands a thorough investigation amid doubts from affected municipalities.

title: Real wages in Japan rise for eighth straight month, longest streak in 9.5 years
summary: The 1.5% year-on-year increase in August is attributed to government anti-inflation measures, though recovery is uneven across sectors.

title: Okinawa governor demands effective government measures after arrest of U.S. Marine
summary: Denny Tamaki meets with defense and foreign ministers to request a review of forces' status and reduce base burden.

title: Yamamoto shines with 10 strikeouts in 7 innings, brings Dodgers closer to Championship Series
summary: Japanese pitcher dominates Braves in Game 3 of NLDS; Los Angeles leads series 2-1 and Ohtani draws walk as designated hitter.

title: Former Takenaka construction head re-arrested for overbilling fall-prevention net for Expo 2025 Grand Ring
summary: Prosecutors accuse former Osaka site director of embezzling funds in perimeter fence contract, second arrest in corruption case.

title: Japan arrests suspected key member of ransomware gang as AI-driven cyberattacks rise
summary: Police arrest suspect linked to groups like Qilin; corporate data leaks multiply and loyalty points are fraudulently redeemed.

title: Chiba celebrates contribution to IceCube, awarded Nobel Prize in Physics for detecting cosmic neutrinos
summary: The Antarctic observatory, in which the university has participated since its construction, opens a new window to the high-energy universe.

title: Father denounces daughter's death as 'murder' after she was struck by man who committed suicide by jumping from building
summary: Family collects signatures to have case investigated as homicide rather than accident, arguing victim was not at fault.

title: Government prepares second supplementary budget focused on disasters without broad economic measures
summary: The proposal, of reduced scale, aims to avoid concentration of public works and respond to recent natural disasters.

title: Three years of war in Gaza: Japan seeks its role in peace as chaos worsens in Middle East
summary: Analysts and media debate Japan's contribution amid escalation with Iran and diplomatic stalemate in region.

title: Man arrested for abandoning partner's corpse in Miyagi; autopsy points to suffocation
summary: Victim, found in vehicle, was allegedly strangled and transported from Sendai; suspect denies charges.
